decisions.reason: Uses ls-remote-tags.txt (no v0.9.5) and sync-script.sh (HEAD:main only, no tag refspec) to attribute attempt 1 to undistributed tags, explicitly ruling out network/typo/npm causes.
Explains v0.9.7 targets 0.1.2-alpha.1 whose API adds useConversation while consumer runs 0.1.1-rc.2; installation success and restart cannot fix an API-shape mismatch.

Selects v0.9.3 via rc.1 verification plus additive rc.2 note, notes v0.9.3 is absent from the mirror, and gives the #v0.9.3 command as conditional on maintainer tag push; no invented SHA, no dsh upgrade. The extra v0.9.1 fallback asserts untested compatibility but the primary remedy fully meets the criterion.
Adds git push --tags (or refs/tags/*) per mirror in the sync script, grounded in the branch-only script, plus an ls-remote CI gate verifying documented tags resolve on every mirror.
Proposes a runtime-to-tag table (rc.x → v0.9.3, alpha.x → v0.9.7), version check/engines declaration, and per-line tag series; no newest-tag default or untested-future generalization.
